notes:
ACCESS: plain curl_cffi direct fetch, HTTP 200 on every request, no WAF, no proxy, no impersonation tricks needed. www.schoolhouse.com 301s to schoolhouse.com; every link recorded is the page's own rel=canonical. Platform: Shopify. ROBOTS: https://schoolhouse.com/robots.txt fetched FIRST (5,689 bytes) and read in full. Groups present: '*', 'adsbot-google', 'Nutch' (Disallow: /), 'AhrefsBot', 'AhrefsSiteAudit', 'MJ12bot', 'Pinterest'. There is NO group naming ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai or Claude-Web, and no Content-Signal line. The generic '*' group disallows /admin, /cart, /orders, /checkout(s), /account, /search, /policies/, /services, /collections/*sort_by*, /collections/*+*, /collections/*filter*&*filter*, and hashed -remote product URLs. Every URL used below is a bare /collections/ with no sort_by, no '+', and at most a single ?page= parameter, so nothing disallowed was requested. No Crawl-delay applies to us (the only Crawl-delay lines sit in the AhrefsBot / AhrefsSiteAudit / MJ12bot / Pinterest groups); probe.py still paced 2s per host. TREE: taken from the live server-rendered mega-menu in the homepage HTML (both the desktop 'mega-menu__list' markup and the mobile 'menu-drawer__submenu' markup, which agree item-for-item). The BED + BATH department contains a grouped column headed 'Bath' -> /collections/all-bathroom with exactly three children: Bathroom Hardware -> /collections/bath-hardware, Bathroom Lighting -> /collections/bathroom-lighting, Bathroom Mirrors -> /collections/mirrors. There is no fourth level: each of those three PLPs was fetched and its
contains no subcategory anchors at all (the only /collections/ hrefs are the facet 'Clear'/'Remove all' self-links). /collections/all-bathroom is therefore emitted as a grouping row with blank qty and blank link under rule 24/38 and its own URL is NOT recorded. QTY: every number is the listing page's own server-rendered header, N products (the mobile span carries the same value; both are quoted by the regex used). Shopify products_count / products.json was NOT used as the count source. VERIFICATION: (a) header == enumerated unique /products/ slugs in the grid on every single-page collection measured - all-bathroom 23/23, bath-hardware 19/19, bathroom-lighting 12/12, mirrors 8/8, all-bathroom-kitchen-hardware 11/11, wall-hardware 9/9, in-stock-bath 19/19, hooks-racks 8/8, ceiling-wall-hardware 8/8, shelves-ledges 1/1, shower-curtains 2/2, bed-bath 21/21. (b) PAGINATION PROOF that the header is a true total and not a page cap: /collections/all-bed-bath reports '48 products' and serves 24 unique slugs on ?page=1, a DIFFERENT 24 on ?page=2 and zero on ?page=3, union exactly 48. Both recorded leaves are far under the 24 page size and show no pagination markup. (c) second reads of bath-hardware (19) and mirrors (8) taken minutes later returned identical values - no drift. (d) the numbers discriminate (23/19/12/11/9/8/2/1), so this is not a site-wide constant. (e) every page's h1 matches the node requested - 'Collection: Bath', 'Collection: Bath Hardware', 'Collection: Mirrors', 'Collection: Bathroom Lighting'. OVERLAP (disclosed, not an error): the site's own taxonomy makes the two recorded leaves overlap. All 8 products in /collections/mirrors are also inside /collections/bath-hardware, i.e. bath-hardware (19) = 8 mirrors + 11 hooks/knobs/pulls (J Hook, Mollie Hook, Mollie Double Hook, Mollie Multi Hook, Perkins Hook, Perkins Hook Rail, Remy Hook, Roland Knob, Roland Pull, Turned Wood Knob, Galley Pull). They are SIBLINGS in the site's nav, not parent and child, so both are emitted per rules 23/28 and the quantities are NOT aggregated. This is the same overlapping-cover pattern the Furniture pass on this company documented. Conversely /collections/all-bathroom (23) is not the union of its three children: it adds 8 cabinet knobs (Ceramic Ball, Ceramic Dish, Forma, Newberg, Parker, Remy, Rhone, Somerset) and the 2 shower curtains, and omits all 8 mirrors - another reason its own URL is not recorded as a leaf. MIRRORS DECISION (rule 10/11/29): /collections/mirrors is reached from TWO nav paths - Bed + Bath > Bath > 'Bathroom Mirrors' and Decor > 'Mirrors'. Rule 28 makes that one record, and it is classed Bathroom because the primary product type is a mirror (rule 11, not lighting) and because the site itself puts the entire 8-piece mirror range inside /collections/bath-hardware. The 8 are Bobbin Mirror (3 variants as separate handles), Forma Mirror, Grant Mirror, Leo Mirror, Nathan Mirror, Oak Chamfered Mirror. DEDUP: dedup.already_extracted() was called on all eight candidate URLs (bath-hardware, mirrors, bathroom-lighting, all-bathroom, all-bathroom-kitchen-hardware, wall-hardware, in-stock-bath, all-bed-bath) and on the www. form of the three that matter. ZERO hits. The exclusion index holds 12 schoolhouse.com URLs, all from Furniture.xlsx and all general furniture (living-room-furniture, bedroom-furniture, dining-furniture, storage-furniture, dining-tables, coffee-and-side-tables, nightstands-side-tables, consoles-credenzas, sideboards-and-buffets, dining-chairs, stools-benches, carts-and-racks) - no bath node was previously taken. EXCLUDED and why: /collections/all-bed-bath and /collections/all-bathroom own URL and /collections/all-hardware (Shop all / parent, rules 24-25); /collections/in-stock-bath (19), in-stock-hardware, in-stock-bed-bath (availability filters, not categories - same treatment the Furniture pass gave 'In Stock Furniture'); /collections/bed-bath (21 products, all quilts, shams, sheet sets, duvets and pillows - Textile/bedding, not bathroom); /collections/wall-hardware (9) and /collections/hooks-racks (8) and /collections/ceiling-wall-hardware (8) and /collections/shelves-ledges (1) - general Hardware-department wall hooks and a wall shelf, not presented under Bath, and 7-8 of their products are already inside the recorded bath-hardware leaf. The full collections sitemap (sitemap_collections_1.xml, 564 collections) was swept for bath/shower/towel/mirror/hook/soap/vanity/toilet/sink/faucet/shelf/hardware slugs to catch unlinked legacy nodes; six of the bath-relevant ones resolve but are EMPTY and are therefore not recordable - /collections/bathroom-accessories '0 products', /collections/towel-bars '0 products', /collections/towel-rings '0 products', /collections/toiletries '0 products', /collections/bath-mats '0 products', /collections/door-hardware '0 products' (each verified by both the header and a zero-slug grid). The remaining matches are campaign/collection-name pages (sale-bath, bath-favorites, new-bed-bath, bed-bath-bestsellers, bfcm-all-hardware, mara-hardware, roland-hardware, remy-hardware, belmont-hardware, knurled-hardware, cove-hardware-collection and similar) and are excluded under rule 25. NET: this lighting/hardware maker has a small but genuine Bathroom department - 2 leaves, 27 products across them before overlap.
